additional_sources.title: INEOS Energy UK: 2024 Environmental Report
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report contains explicit 2024 Breagh and Clipper South combustion CO2/N2O/CH4/CO2e rows and separate maintenance-venting CO2e rows. Combustion and venting scopes remain separate and offshore.

additional_sources.title: NEO Energy: OSPAR Annual Public Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report explicitly states 116,595 tonnes CO2 from GPIII combustion/flaring and 19.3 tonnes CO2 from venting, fugitive emissions and propane. Screenshot verification succeeded for the relevant page.

additional_sources.title: ONE-Dyas UK Limited: UK Annual Environmental Report 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official report explicitly gives Sean Papa 2024 cumulative December CO2 of 33,297 tonnes and 2024 venting CH4 of 366 tonnes. The rounded 33.3 thousand tonne narrative is used only as a cross-check, not a second row.

additional_sources.title: Petrofac Facilities Management Limited: UKCS Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official report provides explicit 2024 CO2, CH4 and refrigerant CO2e values for Hewett, Kittiwake, Irish Sea Pioneer and several intervention/drilling activities. Hewett, Kittiwake and ISP/Island Frontier pages were visually screenshot-verified; activity rows remain non-cadastral.

additional_sources.title: Petrogas North Sea Limited: Annual Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official table reports explicit 2024 CO2e totals for Birgitta Survey, Baker Survey, Baker Drilling and the combined total. Because machine-readable column alignment for intermediate pollutants is less robust, only the unambiguous final CO2e column is promoted.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Explicit facility/activity, gas, quantity, unit, period and method provenance are required. Offshore facility/activity measurements cannot become England cadastral parcel values.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit or facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Aggregate, graph-only or ambiguous-layout evidence cannot become a measured row without an explicit printed quantity and compatible scope.

web_research_basis: Fresh official GOV.UK/OPRED research on 2026-07-27. Five additional 2024 annual-report surfaces were selected after dedupe against batches 169-180. Screenshot verification was attempted for every PDF used; NEO and Petrofac pages succeeded while some government-asset screenshots returned cache misses. No OCR or axis interpolation was used.
